**Severity:** error · **Area:** Imports / helpers / route modules (`RV3xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Server clientOnly must be called directly through its named import binding
```

## How to fix

Call `clientOnly(...)` directly where it is used; do not store, pass or alias the clientOnly binding.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { clientOnly } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
export const c = [clientOnly];
```

```tsx prefer
import { clientOnly } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
export const Map = clientOnly(() => import("./map"));
```

## When it is reported

Server target.
